channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is characterized by widespread remote code execution and privilege escalation risks targeting enterprise infrastructure, with Microsoft ecosystems accounting for the majority of high-severity flaws across desktop operating systems, cloud services, and databases. Memory corruption vulnerabilities in Windows networking protocols, SQL Server, and Office applications facilitate unauthenticated attacks, while cloud platforms and web portals suffer from authentication bypasses and injection flaws that threaten identity management and data integrity. Concurrently, critical weaknesses in IoT firmware, industrial control devices, and AI development tools expose operational technology and automated workflows to supply chain compromises and unauthorized device manipulation.
